messages:
Elena: Quick standup for the benchmark launch social push. Need to finalize X thread + LinkedIn post, visuals, and routing. Can we lock times by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Marcus: Ill own copy. Two short variants for X and a longer LinkedIn draft. Dropping drafts in the doc in 30m.
Devon: I can produce hero + two stat cards and a 9:16 clip. ETA 4pm PT. Will add alt text.
Sophie: Engagement plan: community to monitor first 6 hours, reply to top comments within 90 minutes, and compile top 10 questions for product. Also plan a follow-up thread 24h later with a poll.
Elena: Routing: please add utm params so leads land in the benchmark_webinar queue. Proposed: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x&utm_campaign=bench_launch_sept. Also add hidden form field campaign=bench_launch_sept.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduler requires ISO times + legal + product ack. Use the command: `schedule --chan x --time "2025-09-22T15:30:00Z" --text copy_x.txt --media hero.png --utm bench_launch_sept`.
Marcus: Draft X opener (variant A): "New benchmark: optimized serving reduces per-token spend by up to 3x. See configs + results in our webinar. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Marcus: Variant B: "Lower cost, same quality. Our benchmark shows practical wins for inference serving. Join the webinar: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
Devon: Uploaded files to the marketing drive: hero_final.png, stat_card_a.png, stat_card_b.png, clip_9_16.mp4, alt_texts.md.
Elena: Legal please review the "3x" wording and confirm the baseline to include on the landing page. @legal-team
legal-team: We'll review. Quick ask: include the exact baseline phrase on the landing page (e.g., "compared to default open-source configs"). Reply here when updated.
Sophie: For engagement follow-ups: growth will run the first reply sweep, community will handle product questions, and PR will monitor journalist replies. If engagement exceeds 200 replies, comms to escalate.
Marcus: I'll trim the LinkedIn preview to 250 chars and paste ISO times when final. Tentative schedule: X thread first tweet 2025-09-22T15:30:00Z, LinkedIn 2025-09-22T17:00:00Z, Reminder 2025-09-23T16:00:00Z.
Elena: Great. Checklist: 
- [ ] Final copy (Marcus)
- [ ] Visuals + alt text (Devon)
- [ ] Legal ack on claims (legal-team)
- [ ] UTM + form hidden field wired (ops)
- [ ] Scheduler ISO times posted (Marcus)
- [ ] Engagement rota set (Sophie)
Marcus: Final copy posted in doc and pasted here for quick glance: "Our benchmark shows that optimized serving reduces per-token spend by up to 3x vs default configs, without measurable quality loss. Join our webinar for configs, numbers, and demos: https://redwood.ai/webinar"
legal-team: Reviewed and ok after adding baseline text to the landing page. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: CRM mapping updated: hidden field `campaign=bench_launch_sept` -> queue `benchmark_webinar` assigned to the demand team.
Devon: All assets exported and uploaded. File names: hero_final.png, stat_a.png, stat_b.png, clip_9_16.mp4.
Sophie: Community brief created. First reply window 90 mins, escalation at 200+ replies, poll scheduled for 24h after launch.
Elena: Locked. Marcus please post ISO scheduler commands here and I'll queue them. Thanks team! :rocket:
